🎬 Simon Says (2026)

A 21st birthday celebration takes a horrifying turn when an unexpected guest introduces the group to a twisted version of Simon Says. What starts with playful commands and harmless dares soon becomes something far more dangerous, as refusing to follow the rules brings terrifying consequences.

Trapped in an increasingly brutal game, the friends are pushed through one sinister challenge after another while desperately searching for a way out. As panic takes over and trust begins to crumble, surviving the night means figuring out who is really controlling the game before it’s too late.

Packed with slasher thrills, dark comedy, bloody chaos, and unexpected twists, Simon Says turns a childhood party game into a deadly fight for survival. Watch the full movie now on Tubi.
